Rika — Park Hyatt Hyderabad (2018).

A restaurant identity built on one element: a single red flame, set against black with a slash of crimson. The flame becomes a laser-cut detail on cards and coasters, the 'RIKA' wordmark sits quiet beside it, and crimson tableware carries the heat through the room.

Restaurant identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·61.
